scripts.dev:worker: docker compose --env-file backend/.env --profile workers up -d worker-extract worker-fast
scripts.dev:worker:extract: docker compose --env-file backend/.env --profile workers up -d worker-extract
scripts.dev:worker:fast: docker compose --env-file backend/.env --profile workers up -d worker-fast
scripts.dev:worker:rebuild: docker compose --env-file backend/.env --profile workers up -d --build worker-extract worker-fast
scripts.format: biome check --write . && uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel ruff format src tests scripts
scripts.lint: biome ci . && eslint app components lib proxy.ts
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write . && eslint --fix app components lib proxy.ts
scripts.lint:py: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel ruff format --check src tests scripts && uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel ruff check src tests scripts && uv run --directory backend --extra dev lint-imports
scripts.lint:py:fix: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel ruff check --fix src tests scripts && uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel ruff format src tests scripts
scripts.typecheck:py: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel pyright
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm deadcode && pnpm lint:py && pnpm typecheck:py
scripts.review:check: pnpm verify && pnpm test:api && pnpm deploy:check
scripts.review:check:fast: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:api:e2e
scripts.test:auth: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel pytest tests/unit/infra/auth tests/integration/infra/auth -q
scripts.test:unit: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel pytest tests/unit -q -m "not live and not slow"
scripts.test:integration: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel pytest tests/integration -q -m "not live and not slow"
scripts.test:api: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel pytest tests/unit tests/integration -v -m "not live and not slow"
scripts.test:api:e2e: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel pytest tests/integration/api/test_routes.py -v --tb=short -m "not live and not slow"
scripts.test:api:slow: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel pytest tests/unit tests/integration -v -m "slow and not live"
scripts.test:live: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel pytest tests/live -v -m live --tb=short
scripts.test:facture: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel pytest tests/live/journeys/test_facture_ui_e2e.py -v -m "e2e_facture and live" --tb=short
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.test:platform:integration: uv run --directory backend --extra dev --extra otel python scripts/platform_integration_suite.py
